summary: Avatar and Badge, both built through add-component and needing no new tokens. Avatar: photo or derived initials, circle/rounded, `name` required in both forms because it is simultaneously the alt text and the initials source; the visible initials are aria-hidden with the full name in an sr-only span, so a screen reader announces the person rather than spelling letters; a real means a broken URL degrades to alt text instead of an empty box. Badge: four variants, two sizes, pill/rounded, rendering a with NO interaction props — the sheet's x and check variants are composed by passing a real button into iconEnd, which keeps the accessible name at the call site and avoids the commonest tag-component defect (a click handler on a span with no role, focus or keyboard path). 12 design bugs fixed in Paper across both, plus Multiselect (see the design-fixes entry).

migration.manual: New items. `npx shadcn add @bydiorama/avatar @bydiorama/badge`; both pull in `cn` and expect react as a peer.
